metadata.scope_decision: User selected page 3 capability table as authoritative; CMD 01..07 only.
metadata.description_decision: User approved profile-local type description because CSV cell is empty.
metadata.unit_variants: Distinct semantic objects preserve wire-unit selection for offline encoding. Energy outputs normalized to Wh; power to W.
runtime_limitations: Virtual-device runtime currently rejects RORG D2; direct offline encoder is supported.
TX encoder does not enforce telegram constraints. Validate nonzero MAT/MIT and MAT seconds >= MIT before physical TX.
This single-output profile addresses output channel 0. Generic input channel 31 and output broadcast 30 are not exposed as separate targets.
